verdict.rationale: Render describes itself as a managed cloud application platform, and nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable or on-premises distribution of Render itself. The ClickHouse item covers running your own software on Render's infrastructure, which is a different capability. Self-hosting is a fair question for a PaaS, so the absence of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
